title: zornia setifera
intro: Zornia setifera, commonly known as "Palo de Aguila", is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Zornia setifera include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Zornia setifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
